Original dishes to discover
Apr 2026 • Couples
We really liked this restaurant!

The dishes are delicious and there is a lot of choice, which allows to vary with each visit. The “combo” menus are particularly interesting: they are very complete, with a main course, a salad and a bowl of rice. Everything is well cooked, tasty and beautifully presented.

We were quite surprised to discover some negative reviews afterwards, because on our side, the experience was excellent from start to finish. During our stay we went five times... and each time we were delighted!

The staff is also very friendly and welcoming. Nothing wrong, a very good address that we recommend without hesitation.

Do not
Mar 2025 • Family
I went for my birthday with my family because it looked nice and the reviews looked good. I was very disappointed 
They claim to be local but only tourists will come here and there is a reason for it. 
We ordered the duck soup which wasn’t available so we went for the goat soup….don’t! There was maybe 3 pieces of fatty slim little meat. We sent it back. 
We ordered combo 1 (duck with soy sauce, salad and rice) - it tasted like a cheap sausage with a little drizzle of soy sauce. 
Dad got a pizza which was ok but nothing local about making pizza in Vietnam lol

We have been in Vietnam for the last 2 weeks and it was the worst restaurant we have been so far.
